description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier token enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier token and the two Soldier tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
